prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: Create a high-fashion studio portrait featuring four young men with identical appearances, each with closely cropped, vibrant pink hair. The subjects are arranged in a relaxed, informal group against a seamless, bright white background, creating a clean and minimalist aesthetic. The first man on the left wears a black tank top and light blue jeans, gesturing animatedly with a friendly, open expression. The second man stands next to him in a white Calvin Klein t-shirt with a bold black "K" logo, and blue jeans, glancing sideways with a slightly curious or amused look. The third man is shirtless, wearing only black jeans, with a serious, intense expression, his arm draped casually over the shoulder of the fourth man. The fourth man, dressed in a black button-up shirt and black jeans, stands with arms crossed, looking off to the side with a reserved, contemplative demeanor. All four have a matching tattoo on their upper left arm. The lighting is soft and even, eliminating harsh shadows and emphasizing the smoothness of their skin and the vividness of their hair. The overall composition is balanced and contemporary, with a subtle sense of camaraderie and individuality among the group, evoking the style of a modern fashion campaign.
